notes.modes: Ohio reports a contest's votes as one Total per county. The absentee and provisional split is published on the COUNTY, not on the contest, so early_and_mail_counted uses the county's absentee ballots - an approximation, unlike North Carolina's exact split.
notes.outstanding: Outstanding UOCAVA absentees and provisionals are Ohio's own figures, not derived here.
notes.election_day: Ballots still to come on election day are not estimated; only precincts not yet reporting are shown.
notes.test: feed_status and is_test_data come from the feed. Ohio runs mock elections before election day; a board must not show mock votes as real, so this flag travels with the data.
